acceptance.title: Acceptance of these Terms
acceptance.p1: By accessing or using Bookie (“the Service”), you agree to these Terms of Service and to our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

service.title: The Service
service.p1: Bookie is an online booking platform. Service providers publish a booking page with their services and working hours, and clients find providers and book appointments with them. Bookie provides the platform only: the services themselves are delivered by the providers, who are solely responsible for them.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.p1: You need an account to publish a booking page or to keep your bookings in one place; clients can also book without one. You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details confidential, for everything done under your account, and for keeping your information accurate. We may suspend or close accounts that break these Terms.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.p1: A booking is an arrangement between a client and a provider. Providers set their own services, prices, schedules and cancellation terms, and are paid directly by their clients — Bookie does not take payments for appointments. Bookie is not a party to that arrangement and is not responsible for a provider's services or a client's attendance.

content.title: Your content
content.p1: Providers are responsible for what they publish — descriptions, prices, photos and contact details — and must have the right to publish it. Clients are responsible for the reviews they write, which must describe a real experience. We may hide reviews or remove content that is unlawful, misleading or abusive.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.p1: You agree not to break any law through the Service, impersonate anyone, make bookings you do not intend to keep, upload malicious code or harmful content, try to gain unauthorized access to Bookie's systems or other people's accounts, or scrape the Service in a way that places unreasonable load on it.

plans.title: Plans and payments
plans.p1: Booking is always free for clients. Providers can use Bookie for free or subscribe to a paid plan, billed monthly until cancelled, at the prices on our <pricing>pricing page</pricing>. Taxes may apply depending on where you are. You can switch or cancel your plan at any time from your Plan settings; a cancellation takes effect at the end of the month you have paid for. For refunds, see our <refund>Refund Policy</refund>.
plans.p2: Our order process is conducted by our online reseller Paddle.com. Paddle.com is the Merchant of Record for all our orders. Paddle provides all customer service inquiries and handles returns.

planChanges.title: Changes to plans and prices
planChanges.p1: We may change our plans or prices. A price change applies to an existing subscription from its next billing period, and we will tell you by email before it does. Moving to a smaller plan, or ending one, never takes away what your clients already see: bookings stay, and your page keeps working within the Free plan's limits.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.p1: You keep ownership of what you publish on Bookie, and you give us a license to host, display and process it only to provide the Service. The Bookie platform, software and design remain our property.

termination.title: Ending your use of Bookie
termination.p1: You can delete your account at any time from your account settings. We may suspend or end your access if you break these Terms. A paid plan then ends at the close of its current billing period.

disclaimer.title: No warranties
disclaimer.p1: The Service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted or error-free, or that any booking will take place.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.p1: To the fullest extent the law allows, Bookie is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, or for any dispute between a client and a provider. Our total liability for any claim is limited to what you paid us in the twelve months before it.

changes.title: Changes to these Terms
changes.p1: We may update these Terms. We will publish the new version here with a new date. Continuing to use the Service after an update means you accept the new Terms.

privacy.intro: Bookie (“we”, “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, why, who we share it with, and the choices you have.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.p1: Account information: your name, email address, phone number and password, which is stored only as a one-way hash. If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account identifier and email address.
collect.p2: Provider pages: what a provider publishes — description, photos, services, prices, working hours, address and contact details — is public by design.
collect.p3: Bookings: the service, time, notes and preferred payment method of each booking, and — for a booking made without an account — the name, phone number and optional email address entered with it.
collect.p4: Reviews clients write about providers, and reports about reviews.
collect.p5: Telegram: if you connect Telegram for notifications, your Telegram chat identifier and username.
collect.p6: Billing: for providers on a paid plan, Paddle's customer and subscription identifiers and the subscription status. Payment details go to Paddle and never reach us.

use.title: How we use it
use.p1: To run your account and your bookings; to send booking emails — confirmations, changes, cancellations and reminders — and, if you connected it, the same notices on Telegram; to show provider pages and reviews to the public; to process subscriptions; to keep the Service secure and prevent abuse; and to answer you when you contact us.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.p1: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the services that run parts of Bookie for us, and only as much as they need:
sharing.p2: Paddle — our reseller and Merchant of Record, for subscription payments, invoices and tax. Paddle handles payment details under its own privacy policy.
sharing.p3: Our email delivery service — sends account and booking emails.
sharing.p4: Telegram — delivers notifications, only if you connect it.
sharing.p5: Google — signs you in, only if you choose to continue with Google.
sharing.p6: A booking's details are shared with the provider it is made with, and the provider's public contact details with the client — that is what a booking is.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: We use strictly necessary cookies only: one that keeps you signed in for up to 7 days, short-lived ones that hold a Google sign-in in progress, and one that remembers your language. We use no advertising or analytics cookies.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.p1: We keep your data while your account exists. Deleting your account from your settings deletes it and your profile; a client account with appointments on record needs those cancelled first. Billing records are also kept by Paddle as tax law requires.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can see and correct most of your data in your settings, and delete your account there. For a copy of your data, or any other request about it, <contact>contact us</contact>.

security.title: Security
security.p1: Everything travels over HTTPS. Passwords are stored only as Argon2id hashes, links we email are single-use and expire, and sign-in attempts are rate-limited.

children.title: Children
children.p1: Bookie is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: We may update this policy. We will publish the new version here with a new date.

subscriptions.title: Paid plans
subscriptions.p1: Bookie's paid plans for providers are monthly subscriptions, billed in advance by Paddle, our reseller and Merchant of Record. Clients never pay Bookie anything.

cancel.title: Cancelling
cancel.p1: You can cancel at any time under Manage billing on your Plan settings. You keep your plan until the end of the month you have paid for, and you are not charged again.

eligibility.title: Refunds
eligibility.p1: If you are not happy with a paid plan, ask for a refund within 14 days of your first payment for it and we will refund that payment in full. After that, we refund any charge made by mistake — for example a duplicate payment, or a renewal after you had cancelled.

planChanges.title: Switching plans
planChanges.p1: Switching plans is prorated: moving up charges the difference for the rest of the month, and moving down credits it against your next payments.

request.title: How to ask for a refund
request.p1: <contact>Contact us</contact> with the email address of your Bookie account and the date of the charge, and we will reply within 2 business days. You can also reach Paddle from the receipt they emailed you.

processing.title: How refunds are paid
processing.p1: Approved refunds are made by Paddle to your original payment method. Depending on your bank, they can take 5–10 business days to arrive.

clientsPay.a: No. Booking through Bookie is always free for clients, on every plan. Only providers choose a plan.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes. Cancel under Manage billing on your Plan settings. Your plan stays active until the end of the month you have paid for, then your account moves to Free.

downgrade.q: What happens to my page if I move to a smaller plan?
downgrade.a: Nothing your clients can see is taken away. Services above the new limit stay live and editable — you just cannot add more until you are under it. Bookings are never cancelled by a plan change.

switching.a: Yes, at any time from your Plan settings. The change applies right away, and the difference for the rest of the month is charged or credited automatically.

paymentProcessor.a: Payments are processed by Paddle, our reseller and Merchant of Record. Paddle accepts cards and other local payment methods, sends your receipts and invoices, and handles sales tax and VAT.

currency.q: Which currency will I pay in?
currency.a: Where Paddle supports it, prices are shown and charged in your local currency, including any tax that applies where you are. Otherwise they are shown in US dollars, before tax.

failedPayment.a: Paddle tries your card again and emails you. Your plan keeps working for a week while you update your payment method; after that your account moves to Free until a payment goes through.

refunds.a: Yes — ask within 14 days of your first payment for a plan, or any time a charge was made by mistake. See our <refund>refund policy</refund>.
